REGULAR MEETING OF THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item.Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City’s website under Parklands Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
The Parklands Committee, at the direction of the Committee Chair with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Parklands Committee meetings.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: This meeting will be held in person at the City Council Chambers of City Hall, 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274. The meeting may not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to aseims@pvestates.org . Comments received by NOON on Thursday, September 8, 2022, will be posted online with the agenda. Comments received by NOON on Thursday, September 8, 2022 will be forwarded to the Committee Members and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda. To allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the Committee is requested to fill out a speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of Committee minute preparation. When called upon to speak please, state your name for the record. All speakers will receive 3 minutes to speak during public comment or on the item indicated. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance. If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12:00 PM (Noon) on September 8, 2022 to cmoritz@pvestates.org
